data.name: Wanderer's Shroud
data.description: Your wanderings often go unnoticed. Efforts to use the Diplomacy skill to gather information about you take a -1 penalty, and you gain a +1 trait bonus on all saving throws against scrying and mindreading effects that allow saving throws.
